0022600108.text: The Bulls (1-1, second in the Central and seventh in the East) host the Wizards (1-1, second in the Southeast and fifth in the East) in Chicago's third game of the 2026-27 season, with Chicago on a one-game winning streak and Washington on a one-game losing streak. Nic Claxton is out for Chicago with a hamstring injury, while Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and AJ Dybantsa is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Bulls won all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 119-108 in Washington on April 9, 2026.
